change_reason: The previous implementation treated a missing or empty shard record file as recoverable even when a manifest already existed. That partial state was narrower than a valid completed shard but broader than the documented completely-missing-shard recovery contract.

current_state_machine.shard_and_manifest_both_absent: Mark exactly that shard as eligible for recovery.
current_state_machine.both_exist_and_are_nonempty: Require complete record, partition, invariant, protocol, path, and manifest validation before reuse.
current_state_machine.any_recovery_child_fails: Preserve all outputs and return failure without aggregation.
current_state_machine.all_four_shards_validate: Aggregate and run the frozen full-benchmark verifier.

operational_rule: Do not invoke this tool while the current evaluation is healthy. On a later card, first establish that no target evaluator or residual EngineCore exists, then invoke --dry-run before any recovery execution.
